title: Pikmin 4 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy: Metacritic user score 2 out of 10 (257 users) against a Metascore of 83 (25 critics)
label: جديد

sources.name: Metacritic, Pikmin 4: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy, user and critic scores (read 12:12Z 16 Nov)
TheGamer, review-bombed and labelled a scam (16 Nov 09:27Z)

first_report: TheGamer 16 Nov 2026 04:27 EST (09:27Z); Metacritic page read 12:12Z: user score 2 (max 10) from 257 user reviews (49 positive, 3 mixed, 205 negative), Metascore 83 from 25 critics
footage: Nintendo's own product video for the Switch 2 Edition (nintendo.com store, nsuid 70010000135059), 720p

angle.hook: critics gave Pikmin 4's Switch 2 Edition 83 out of 100; users on Metacritic give it 2 out of 10
angle.why_now: the user score dropped in the days after the 12 Nov launch, reported by TheGamer this morning
angle.what_it_means_here: players deciding whether to pay for the upgrade see that most user reviews complain about its value, while critics rated it well
angle.payoff: the edition came out on 12 Nov with the new Dandori Academy mode
